segments.source: Bases as Coordinate Systems
Learn to view a basis as a coordinate system on a subspace.
segments.translation: 기저를 부분공간 위의 좌표계로 보는 법을 배웁니다.

segments.source: Recipes: compute the \cB-coordinates of a vector, compute the usual coordinates of a vector from its \cB-coordinates.
segments.translation: 절차: 벡터의 \cB-좌표 계산하기, 벡터의 \cB-좌표로부터 일반적인 좌표 계산하기.

segments.source: Picture: the \cB-coordinates of a vector using its location on a nonstandard coordinate grid.
segments.translation: 그림: 비표준 좌표 격자 위에서 벡터의 위치를 이용해 나타낸 벡터의 \cB-좌표.

segments.source: Vocabulary word: \cB-coordinates.
In this section, we interpret a basis of a subspace V as a coordinate system on V, and we learn how to write a vector in V in that coordinate system.
segments.translation: 이 절에서는 부분공간 V의 기저를 V 위의 좌표계로 해석하고, V에 속한 벡터를 그 좌표계로 나타내는 방법을 배웁니다.

segments.source:
If <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m> is a basis for a subspace <m>V</m>, then any vector <m>x</m> in <m>V</m> can be written as a linear combination
        <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</me>
        in exactly one way.
segments.translation: <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m>가 부분공간 <m>V</m>의 기저이면, <m>V</m>에 속한 임의의 벡터 <m>x</m>는 일차결합 <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</me>로 정확히 한 가지 방법으로 나타낼 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Recall that to say \cB is a basis for V means that \cB spans V and \cB is linearly independent.
Since <m>\cB</m> spans <m>V</m>, we can write any <m>x</m> in <m>V</m> as a linear combination of <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m>.
segments.translation: <m>\cB</m>가 <m>V</m>를 생성하므로, <m>V</m>에 속한 임의의 <m>x</m>를 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m>의 일차결합으로 나타낼 수 있습니다.

segments.source:
For uniqueness, suppose that we had two such expressions:
        <md>
          <mrow>x &= c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</mrow>
          <mrow>x &= c_1'v_1 + c_2'v_2 + \cdots + c_m'v_m.</mrow>
        </md>
segments.translation:
유일성을 보이기 위해, 그러한 표현이 두 가지 있다고 가정합시다. <md>
          <mrow>x &= c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</mrow>
          <mrow>x &= c_1'v_1 + c_2'v_2 + \cdots + c_m'v_m.</mrow>
        </md>

segments.source:
Subtracting the first equation from the second yields
        <me>0 = x-x = (c_1-c_1')v_1 + (c_2-c_2')v_2 + \cdots + (c_m-c_m')v_m.</me>
segments.translation: 두 번째 식에서 첫 번째 식을 빼면 다음을 얻습니다. <me>0 = x-x = (c_1-c_1')v_1 + (c_2-c_2')v_2 + \cdots + (c_m-c_m')v_m.</me>

segments.source: Since <m>\cB</m> is linearly independent, the only solution to the above equation is the trivial solution: all the coefficients must be zero.
segments.translation: <m>\cB</m>가 일차독립이므로, 위 방정식의 유일한 해는 자명해입니다. 즉, 모든 계수가 0이어야 합니다.

segments.source: It follows that <m>c_i-c_i'</m> for all <m>i</m>, which proves that <m>c_1=c_1',\,c_2=c_2',\ldots,\,c_m=c_m'</m>.

Consider the standard basis of <m>\R^3</m> from this <xref ref="dimension-eg-Rn"/>:
      <me>e_1=\vec{1 0 0},\quad e_2=\vec{0 1 0}, \quad e_3=\vec{0 0 1}.</me>
segments.translation: 이 <xref ref="dimension-eg-Rn"/>에서 다룬 <m>\R^3</m>의 표준 기저를 생각해 봅시다. <me>e_1=\vec{1 0 0},\quad e_2=\vec{0 1 0}, \quad e_3=\vec{0 0 1}.</me>

segments.source: According to the above <xref ref="dimension-unique-coeff"/>, every vector in <m>\R^3</m> can be written as a linear combination of <m>e_1,e_2,e_3</m>, with unique coefficients.
segments.translation: 위의 <xref ref="dimension-unique-coeff"/>에 따르면, <m>\R^3</m>의 모든 벡터는 <m>e_1,e_2,e_3</m>의 일차결합으로 유일한 계수를 가지고 나타낼 수 있습니다.

segments.source: In this case, the coordinates of v are exactly the coefficients of e_1,e_2,e_3.
What exactly are coordinates, anyway?
One way to think of coordinates is that they give directions for how to get to a certain point from the origin.
segments.translation: 좌표를 생각하는 한 가지 방법은, 좌표가 원점에서 어떤 점까지 가는 길을 안내해 준다고 보는 것입니다.

segments.source: In the above example, the linear combination <m>3e_1+5e_2-2e_3</m> can be thought of as the following list of instructions: start at the origin, travel <m>3</m> units north, then travel <m>5</m> units east, then <m>2</m> units down.
segments.translation: 위의 예에서 일차결합 <m>3e_1+5e_2-2e_3</m>은 다음과 같은 지시 목록으로 생각할 수 있습니다. 원점에서 출발하여 북쪽으로 <m>3</m>만큼 이동하고, 이어서 동쪽으로 <m>5</m>만큼 이동한 다음, 아래로 <m>2</m>만큼 이동합니다.

segments.source:
Let <m>\cB=\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m> be a basis of a subspace <m>V</m>, and let
        <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</me>
        be a vector in <m>V</m>.
segments.translation: <m>\cB=\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m>를 부분공간 <m>V</m>의 기저라 하고, <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</me>를 <m>V</m>에 속한 벡터라 합시다.

segments.source: The coefficients <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_m</m> are the <term>coordinates of <m>x</m> with respect to <m>\cB</m></term>.

The <term><m>\cB</m>-coordinate vector of <m>x</m></term> is the vector
        <me>[x]_\cB = \vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_m} \quad\text{in }\R^m.</me>

<idx><h><m>\cB</m>-coordinates</h><h>informally</h></idx>
    If we change the basis, then we can still give instructions for how to get to the point <m>(3,5,-2)</m>, but the instructions will be different.
segments.translation: <idx><h><m>\cB</m>-coordinates</h><h>informally</h></idx> 기저를 바꾸더라도 점 <m>(3,5,-2)</m>까지 가는 길을 여전히 안내할 수 있지만, 그 지시는 달라집니다.

segments.source:
Say for example we take the basis
    <me>v_1=e_1+e_2 = \vec{1,1,0}, \quad v_2=e_2 = \vec{0 1 0},\quad v_3 =e_3 = \vec{0 0 1}.</me>
segments.translation: 예를 들어 다음 기저를 택한다고 합시다. <me>v_1=e_1+e_2 = \vec{1,1,0}, \quad v_2=e_2 = \vec{0 1 0},\quad v_3 =e_3 = \vec{0 0 1}.</me>

segments.source: We can write <m>(3,5,-2)</m> in this basis as <m>3v_1+2v_2-2v_3</m>.
In other words: start at the origin, travel northeast <m>3</m> times as far as <m>v_1</m>, then <m>2</m> units east, then <m>2</m> units down.
segments.translation: 다시 말해, 원점에서 출발하여 북동쪽으로 <m>v_1</m>의 <m>3</m>배만큼 이동하고, 이어서 동쪽으로 <m>2</m>만큼 이동한 다음, 아래로 <m>2</m>만큼 이동합니다.

segments.source: In this situation, we can say that <q><m>3</m> is the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate of <m>(3,5,-2)</m>, <m>2</m> is the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate of <m>(3,5,-2)</m>, and <m>-2</m> is the <m>v_3</m>-coordinate of <m>(3,5,-2)</m>.</q>
The above gives a way of using \R^m to label the points of a subspace of dimension m: a point is simply labeled by its \cB-coordinate vector.
segments.translation: 위의 는 \R^m을 이용하여 차원이 m인 부분공간의 점들에 이름을 붙이는 방법을 제공합니다. 즉, 각 점에 그 점의 \cB-좌표 벡터로 이름을 붙이면 됩니다.

segments.source: For instance, if we choose a basis for a plane, we can label the points of that plane with the points of <m>\R^2</m>.
segments.translation: 예를 들어, 평면의 기저를 하나 택하면 그 평면의 점들에 <m>\R^2</m>의 점들로 이름을 붙일 수 있습니다.

segments.source: A nonstandard coordinate system on <m>\R^2</m>
Verify that <m>\cB</m> is a basis for <m>\R^2</m>.
If <m>[w]_\cB = {1\choose 2}</m>, then what is <m>w</m>?
Find the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>v = {5\choose 3}.</m>
By the <xref ref="basis-theorem"/>, any two linearly independent vectors form a basis for <m>\R^2</m>.
segments.translation: <xref ref="basis-theorem"/>에 의해, 일차독립인 두 벡터는 모두 <m>\R^2</m>의 기저를 이룹니다.

segments.source: Clearly <m>v_1,v_2</m> are not multiples of each other, so they are linearly independent.

To say <m>[w]_\cB={1\choose 2}</m> means that <m>1</m> is the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate of <m>w</m>, and that <m>2</m> is the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate:
            <me>w = v_1 + 2v_2 = \vec{1 1} + 2\vec{1 -1} = \vec{3 -1}.</me>
We have to solve the vector equation <m>v=c_1v_1 + c_2v_2</m> in the unknowns <m>c_1,c_2</m>.
segments.translation: 미지수 <m>c_1,c_2</m>에 대한 벡터 방정식 <m>v=c_1v_1 + c_2v_2</m>를 풀어야 합니다.

segments.source:
We form an augmented matrix and row reduce:
            <me>\amat{1 1 5; 1 -1 3}
            \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
            \amat{1 0 4; 0 1 1}.</me>

We have <m>c_1=4</m> and <m>c_2=1</m>, so <m>v = 4v_1+v_2</m> and
            <m>[v]_\cB = {4\choose1}.</m>
In the following picture, we indicate the coordinate system defined by <m>\cB</m> by drawing lines parallel to the <q><m>v_1</m>-axis</q> and <q><m>v_2</m>-axis</q>.
segments.translation: 다음 그림에서는 <q><m>v_1</m>-축</q>과 <q><m>v_2</m>-축</q>에 평행한 직선들을 그려 <m>\cB</m>로 정의되는 좌표계를 나타냅니다.

segments.source: Using this grid it is easy to see that the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>v</m> are <m>{5\choose 1}</m>, and that the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>w</m> are <m>{1\choose 2}</m>.
segments.translation: 이 격자를 이용하면 <m>v</m>의 <m>\cB</m>-좌표가 <m>{5\choose 1}</m>이고 <m>w</m>의 <m>\cB</m>-좌표가 <m>{1\choose 2}</m>임을 쉽게 알 수 있습니다.

segments.source:
<latex-code>
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=.7, thin border nodes]

  \draw (-6, -6) rectangle (6, 6);
  \clip (-6, -6) rectangle (6, 6);

  \draw[scale={sqrt(2)}, rotate=45, help lines] (-7, -7) grid (7, 7);
  \draw[vector, seq-blue] (0, 0) to["$v_1$" above left] (1, 1);
  \draw[vector, seq-green] (0, 0) to["$v_2$" below left] (1, -1);

  \point[seq-red, "$w$" {above,text=seq-red}] at (3, -1);

\end{tikzpicture}

segments.source: Residents of Palo Alto refer to northwest as <q>north</q> and to northeast as <q>east</q>.
There is a reason for this: the old road to San Francisco is called El Camino Real, and that road runs from the southeast to the northwest in Palo Alto.
segments.translation: 여기에는 이유가 있습니다. 샌프란시스코로 가는 옛길은 엘카미노레알이라고 불리는데, 이 길이 팰로앨토에서 남동쪽에서 북서쪽으로 뻗어 있기 때문입니다.

segments.source: So when a Palo Alto resident says <q>go south two blocks and east one block</q>, they are giving directions from the origin to the Whole Foods at <m>w</m>.
segments.translation: 따라서 팰로앨토 주민이 <q>남쪽으로 두 블록, 동쪽으로 한 블록 가십시오</q>라고 말한다면, 그것은 원점에서 <m>w</m>에 있는 홀푸드까지 가는 길을 알려 주는 것입니다.

segments.source: A picture of the basis <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2\}</m> of <m>\R^2</m>.
The grid indicates the coordinate system defined by the basis <m>\cB</m>; one set of lines measures the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate, and the other set measures the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate.
segments.translation: 격자는 기저 <m>\cB</m>로 정의되는 좌표계를 나타냅니다. 한 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_1</m>-좌표를 재고, 다른 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_2</m>-좌표를 잽니다.

segments.source: Use the sliders to find the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>w</m>.

Let
      <me>v_1 = \vec[r]{2 -1 1} \quad v_2 = \vec[r]{1 0 -1}.</me>
These form a basis <m>\cB</m> for a plane <m>V = \Span\{v_1,v_2\}</m> in <m>\R^3</m>.
segments.translation: 이 벡터들은 <m>\R^3</m> 안의 평면 <m>V = \Span\{v_1,v_2\}</m>의 기저 <m>\cB</m>를 이룹니다.

<q><m>v_1</m>-축</q>과 <q><m>v_2</m>-축</q>에 평행한 직선들을 그려 <m>\cB</m>로 정의되는 좌표계를 나타냅니다: <latex-code>
  \begin{tikzpicture}[myxyz, z={(0cm,1.2cm)}, thin border nodes]
    \useasboundingbox[resetxy] (-3,-3) rectangle (3,2.3);

    \def\v{(2,-1,1)}
    \def\w{(1,0,-1)}

    \node[coordinate] (X) at \v {};
    \node[coordinate] (Y) at \w {};

    \begin{scope}[x=(X), y=(Y), transformxy]
      \fill[seq4!10, nearly opaque] (-1,-1) rectangle (1,1);
      \draw[step=.5cm, seq4!80, thin] (-1,-1) grid (1,1);
    \end{scope}

    \begin{scope}[x=($.5*(X)$), y=($.5*(Y)$), every label/.append style={fill=none}]
      \point[minimum size=1.5mm, seq1, "$u_1$" {seq1, xshift=-2mm}] at (1,1);
      \point[minimum size=1.5mm, seq2, "$u_2$" {seq2, right}] at (-1,.5);
      \point[minimum size=1.5mm, seq3, "$u_3$" seq3] at (1.5,-.5);
      \point[minimum size=1.5mm, seq5, "$u_4$" {seq5, right}] at (0,1.5);
    \end{scope}

    \draw[vector] (0,0,0) to["$v_1$"'] ($.5*(X)$);
    \draw[vector] (0,0,0) to["$v_2$"] ($.5*(Y)$);

    \node[x=(X),y=(Y),seq-violet] at (0,-1.2) {$V$};

    \point at (0,0,0);
  \end{tikzpicture}
      </latex-code> 그림에서 <m>\color{seq-red}u_1</m>의 <m>v_1</m>-좌표가 <m>1</m>와 같고 <m>v_2</m>-좌표도 마찬가지임을 알 수 있으므로 <m>[\textcolor{seq1}{u_1}]_\cB = {1\choose 1}.</m>입니다.

segments.source:
Similarly, we have
      <me>
        [\textcolor{seq2}{u_2}]_\cB
        = \vec[r]{-1 \frac 12}\qquad
        [\textcolor{seq3}{u_3}]_\cB
        = \vec[r]{\frac 32 -\frac 12}\qquad
        [\textcolor{seq5}{u_4}]_\cB
        = \vec{0 \frac 32}.
      </me>
Left: the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of a vector <m>x</m>.
Right: the vector <m>x</m>.

The violet grid on the right is a picture of the coordinate system defined by the basis <m>\cB</m>; one set of lines measures the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate, and the other set measures the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate.
segments.translation: 오른쪽의 보라색 격자는 기저 <m>\cB</m>로 정의되는 좌표계를 나타낸 그림입니다. 한 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_1</m>-좌표를 재고, 다른 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_2</m>-좌표를 잽니다.

segments.source: Drag the heads of the vectors <m>x</m> and <m>[x]_\cB</m> to understand the correspondence between <m>x</m> and its <m>\cB</m>-coordinate vector.
segments.translation: 벡터 <m>x</m>와 <m>[x]_\cB</m>의 머리를 끌어 보면서 <m>x</m>와 그 <m>\cB</m>-좌표 벡터 사이의 대응 관계를 이해해 보십시오.

segments.source: A coordinate system on a plane
Verify that <m>\cB</m> is a basis for <m>V</m>.
If <m>[w]_\cB = {5\choose 2}</m>, then what is <m>w</m>?

Find the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of
          <m>v = \vec{5 3 5}.</m>
We need to verify that <m>\cB</m> spans <m>V</m>, and that it is linearly independent.
By definition, <m>V</m> is the span of <m>\cB</m>; since <m>v_1</m> and <m>v_2</m> are not multiples of each other, they are linearly independent.
segments.translation: 정의에 의해 <m>V</m>는 <m>\cB</m>의 생성입니다. <m>v_1</m>과 <m>v_2</m>는 서로의 스칼라배가 아니므로 일차독립입니다.

segments.source: This shows in particular that V is a plane.

To say <m>[w]_\cB={5\choose 2}</m> means that <m>5</m> is the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate of <m>w</m>, and that <m>2</m> is the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate:
            <me>w = 5v_1 + 2v_2 = 5\vec{1 0 1} + 2\vec{1 1 1} = \vec{7 2 7}.</me>
We have to solve the vector equation <m>v=c_1v_1 + c_2v_2</m> in the unknowns <m>c_1,c_2</m>.
segments.translation: 미지수 <m>c_1,c_2</m>에 대한 벡터 방정식 <m>v=c_1v_1 + c_2v_2</m>를 풀어야 합니다.

segments.source:
We form an augmented matrix and row reduce:
            <me>\amat{1 1 5; 0 1 3; 1 1 5}
            \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
            \amat{1 0 2; 0 1 3; 0 0 0}.</me>

We have <m>c_1=2</m> and <m>c_2=3</m>, so <m>v = 2v_1+3v_2</m> and
            <m>[v]_\cB = {2\choose 3}.</m>
A picture of the plane <m>V</m> and the basis <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2\}</m>.
The violet grid is a picture of the coordinate system defined by the basis <m>\cB</m>; one set of lines measures the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate, and the other set measures the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate.
segments.translation: 보라색 격자는 기저 <m>\cB</m>가 정의하는 좌표계를 나타낸 것입니다. 한 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_1</m>-좌표를 재고, 다른 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_2</m>-좌표를 잽니다.

segments.source: Use the sliders to find the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>v</m>.
A coordinate system on another plane
Find a basis <m>\cB</m> for <m>V</m>.
Find the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>x = \vec{4 11 8}</m>.

We write <m>V</m> as the column space of a matrix <m>A</m>, then row reduce to find the pivot columns, as in this <xref ref="dimension-eg-basis-span"/>.
            <me>A = \mat{2 -1 2; 3 1 8; 2 1 6} \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
            \mat{1 0 2; 0 1 2; 0 0 0}.
            </me>
segments.translation:
이 <xref ref="dimension-eg-basis-span"/>에서와 같이 <m>V</m>를 행렬 <m>A</m>의 열공간으로 쓴 다음, 행 축약하여 피벗 열을 찾습니다. <me>A = \mat{2 -1 2; 3 1 8; 2 1 6} \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
            \mat{1 0 2; 0 1 2; 0 0 0}.
            </me>

segments.source: The first two columns are pivot columns, so we can take <m>\cB=\{v_1,v_2\}</m> as our basis for <m>V</m>.
segments.translation: 처음 두 열이 피벗 열이므로 <m>\cB=\{v_1,v_2\}</m>를 <m>V</m>의 기저로 택할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: We have to solve the vector equation <m>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2</m>.
segments.translation: 벡터 방정식 <m>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2</m>를 풀어야 합니다.

segments.source:
We form an augmented matrix and row reduce:
            <me>\amat{2 -1 4; 3 1 11; 2 1 8}
            \quad\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\quad
            \amat{1 0 3; 0 1 2; 0 0 0}.</me>

We have <m>c_1 = 3</m> and <m>c_2 = 2</m>, so
            <m>x=3v_1 + 2v_2</m>, and thus <m>[x]_\cB = {3\choose 2}.</m>
A picture of the plane <m>V</m> and the basis <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2\}</m>.
The violet grid is a picture of the coordinate system defined by the basis <m>\cB</m>; one set of lines measures the <m>v_1</m>-coordinate, and the other set measures the <m>v_2</m>-coordinate.
segments.translation: 보라색 격자는 기저 <m>\cB</m>가 정의하는 좌표계를 나타낸 것입니다. 한 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_1</m>-좌표를 재고, 다른 묶음의 직선들은 <m>v_2</m>-좌표를 잽니다.

segments.source: Use the sliders to find the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>x</m>.
Recipes: <m>\cB</m>-coordinates

If <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m> is a basis for a subspace <m>V</m> and <m>x</m> is in <m>V</m>, then
      <me>[x]_\cB = \vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_m} \sptxt{means}
      x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m.
      </me>
segments.translation:
<m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m>가 부분공간 <m>V</m>의 기저이고 <m>x</m>가 <m>V</m>에 속하면, 다음이 성립합니다. <me>[x]_\cB = \vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_m} \sptxt{means}
      x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m.
      </me>

segments.source:
Finding the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of <m>x</m> means solving the vector equation
      <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</me>
      in the unknowns <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_m</m>.
segments.translation: <m>x</m>의 <m>\cB</m>-좌표를 구한다는 것은 미지수 <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_m</m>에 대한 벡터 방정식 <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</me>를 푸는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.source:
This generally means row reducing the augmented matrix
      <me>\amat[c]{| | ,, | |; v_1 v_2 \cdots, v_m x; | | ,, | |}.</me>
segments.translation: 이는 일반적으로 첨가행렬 <me>\amat[c]{| | ,, | |; v_1 v_2 \cdots, v_m x; | | ,, | |}.</me>를 행 축약하는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.source: Let <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m> be a basis of a subspace <m>V</m>.

Finding the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of a vector <m>x</m> means solving the vector equation
      <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m.</me>
segments.translation: 벡터 <m>x</m>의 <m>\cB</m>-좌표를 구한다는 것은 다음 벡터 방정식을 푸는 것을 의미합니다. <me>x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m.</me>

segments.source: If x is not in V, then this equation has no solution, as x is not in V = \Span\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}.
segments.translation: x가 V에 속하지 않으면, x가 V = \Span\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}에 속하지 않으므로 이 방정식은 해를 갖지 않습니다.

segments.source: In other words, the above equation is inconsistent when x is not in V.
segments.translation: 다시 말해, x가 V에 속하지 않을 때 위의 방정식은 해가 없는(inconsistent) 방정식입니다.
